code: library(tidycreel) library(tidycreel.connect)  schema <- creel_schema(   survey_type       = "instantaneous",   # Table names: required by the database backend, ignored for CSV.   # harvest_lengths_table / release_lengths_table both fall back to   # lengths_table, so a source keeping one lengths table needs only this.   interviews_table  = "vwInterviews",   counts_table      = "vwCounts",   catch_table       = "vwCatch",   lengths_table     = "vwLengths",   # Column mappings: right-hand side is the name in your data source   interview_uid_col = "InterviewID",   date_col          = "SurveyDate",   effort_col        = "EffortHours",   catch_col         = "TotalCatch",   trip_status_col   = "TripStatus",   bank_anglers_col  = "BankAnglers",   # Party size: map it whenever your source records it.
